div.div:
ParseState (Pydantic)
──────────────────────
file_path: Path
parsed_document: ParsedDocument | None = None
※ ParsedDocument = parser_dtos.dataclass
parse_status: Literal[
"pending"|"running"|"success"|"failed"
] = "pending"
error_logs: list[ErrorLog] = []

OntologyState (Pydantic)
──────────────────────
source_document: ParsedDocument | None = None

OntologyGraph.edges: list[OntologyEdge]
build_status: Literal[
"pending"|"running"|"success"|"failed"
] = "pending"

div.div:
IndexState (Pydantic)
──────────────────────
chunks: list[RetrievedChunk] = []
indexing_result: IndexingResult | None = None
indexed_count: int = 0
index_status: Literal[
"pending"|"running"
|"success"|"partial"|"failed"
] = "pending"
※ "partial" = IndexingResult.status 정렬
error_logs: list[ErrorLog] = []

div.div:
OntologyGraph (Pydantic, src/db/ontology/models.py)
──────────────────────
nodes: list[OntologyNode]
edges: list[OntologyEdge]
OntologyNode node_type: Standard|Section|Subsection
id, name, standard_type, chapter, effective_date
title, order, content, paragraphs, unresolved_refs
OntologyEdge edge_type: CONTAINS|REFERENCES
|EXCLUDES|HAS_CONDITION|IS_DEFAULT_FOR
from_id, to_id, paragraph, source_text
include, condition_text, unresolved_target

div.div:
📌 범례
──────────────────────
→ 고정 엣지 (조건 없음)
⟿ 조건부 엣지 (route_after_evaluate 기반)
- - → 오류 경로 (error_logs 기록 후 반환)
━━ 보라색: DB 연결
━━ 분홍색: CRAG 재시도 루프백
━━ 주황색: 강제 종료 우회
